name: WhatsApp Channel Auto-Post Bot
description: Auto-post text, images and videos to a WhatsApp Channel on a schedule, with a secure admin dashboard.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Secret used to sign the admin login cookie. A strong random value is generated for you — keep the default.

ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Username for the admin dashboard login.

ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH.description: bcrypt hash of your admin password. Generate it with: npm run hash -- "your-password" (run locally in the whatsapp-bot folder). Alternatively set ADMIN_PASSWORD instead and leave this blank — the plaintext var is only recommended for first boot.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Plaintext admin password fallback if you don't want to compute a bcrypt hash. Leave blank if you set ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH.

CHANNEL_JID.description: Your WhatsApp Channel id, ends with @newsletter (e.g. 120363012345678901@newsletter). Find it via WhatsApp Web or after connecting, from the bot logs.

TIMEZONE.description: Timezone used for recurring cron schedules (IANA name).

DB_PATH.description: SQLite database file location. /tmp is writable but wiped on every dyno restart — attach Heroku File Storage or deploy on a host with a persistent disk for real durability.

UPLOAD_DIR.description: Where uploaded images/videos are stored (see DB_PATH note).

WA_AUTH_DIR.description: WhatsApp session storage (see DB_PATH note). Without a persistent disk you must re-scan the QR code after every restart.
